question: You will see one image. Which of these is it most likely to be? (a) a frame from a top-budget film, a AAA game cinematic or a cinema nature documentary, (b) a stock photograph, (c) a seed catalog or textbook picture, (d) amateur generated art, (e) a real-time web 3D demo. Answer with one letter, a confidence from 0 to 100, and the one thing that most influenced your answer.

votes.answer: a, 81/100. The finely controlled rim lighting picks out individual hairs on the stem against the night sky.
e, 82, the visible real-time 3D rendering traits—specifically the faceted low-poly leaf and field silhouettes combined with a Fresnel rim-light shader and procedural Milky Way skybox.

a, 60. What most influenced me: it looks like a graded 16:9 cinematic frame. A rim-lit young sunflower with fine stem hairs stands in front of a Milky Way sky over ground fog, and that composition reads like a high-end nature documentary or CG film shot. Clean stock astrophotography (b) is the strongest alternative.
a, 76, the fine rim lighting on the stem hairs makes the foreground plant read like a deliberately lit cinematic close-up.
b, 76, isolated rim-lit plant composited on a Milky Way plate in a commercial postcard frame, with photographic noise and no narrative or documentary subject
